quest.title: Troublesome Work
quest.description: Librarian Lisa seems annoyed about her work...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x425, Mora x9475, Adventurer's Experience x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: *yawn* If you're borrowing a book, please register it in the log. The restricted section is currently not lending any books...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Oh? It's you, little cutie.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: It's so good to see you! More refreshing than a strong cup of tea in the afternoon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Clearly you're meant to be working, but you don't seem to have your heart in it at all...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I mean, other than Jean, who really works that earnestly anyway?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: So did you have something you needed?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: ...Or did you just come to see me?

choices.text: I just wanted to see you!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Ooh, a smooth talker. Not what I was expecting.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So Miss Librarian, got any books to recommend?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hmm... Recommended books... Sadly, everything I'd personally recommend is all in the restricted section, which we're not currently lending out.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's with her ominous tone?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Oh, right. Would you be interested in checking out the <color=#00E1FFFF>Teyvat Travel Guide</color>?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I think it would be quite helpful for you as travelers here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh! Sounds like it could be helpful!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Do you think we could take a peek?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I suppose I can try to find you a copy from the list...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Isn't this Lisa's job? What does she mean "I suppose..."?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Oh dear... That's unfortunate. Our copy is currently being borrowed. That said, it is now overdue...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Come to think of it, quite a few of our books are now overdue. I REALLY wish people would just return their books...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: ...on time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! Is Paimon imagining things, or does the air in here suddenly feel a lot more... electrified!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's giving me goosebumps!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Ugh... such a pain. I'm going out to bring those unreturned books back.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: If you'd rather get your hands on that copy of the <color=#00E1FFFF>Teyvat Travel Guide</color> sooner, you'd better come with me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Lisa seems really scary right now, Paimon thinks it would be best if you answer her...?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Oh, ah, yes... YES!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: You really are such a considerate cutie. Let's see, first we can go to...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: The <color=#00E1FFFF>souvenir shop</color>. It's called "With Wind Comes Glory." So let's meet there shortly.

choices.text: Ah... No, I don't think I had anything specific in mind...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Nothing specific? You must just be here to see me then...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hehe... Okay, I won't tease you any further.

choices.text: I do feel sorry for Jean always working so hard...

talks.objective: Talk to Marjorie about returning the library book

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, you're here! Let's begin, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me, Marjorie...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Marjorie, regarding the book you borrowed—

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hello Marjorie, any exciting new items in stock?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Why so surprised? Today is such a special day, it's only natural that I'd want a souvenir to remember it by.

choices.text: Today is just an ordinary day...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: #So it is... In that case, I declare this the "Day of..." the "Day of My Life I Wish I Could Get Back Because I Spent My First Ever Outing With {NICKNAME} Taking Them on an Annoying Errand."

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: Haha... Well, if it's a souvenir you're after, you're in the right place. I'm sure you'll find something that strikes your fancy, Lisa.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: Or you could let your new friend pick something out for you... make it more of an occasion?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yes, yes! Let {NICKNAME} pick!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright then.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: Take a look around, there's sure to be something she'll love.\n<color=#00E1FFFF>(Choose a gift for Lisa.)</color>

choices.text: What about the overdue library book?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Since we came all this way, why don't we put our official business to one side for a moment?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: All work and no play makes life terribly mundane.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Ooh. Is that how you see it?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I suppose there's nothing wrong with that... At your age, these kinds of fleeting fantasies are normal.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Goodness, is that the time? Marjorie, one last thing — about "The Legend of Vennessa"—

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Oh, so you're a fan of the gallant Lady Vennessa too? Why didn't you say so? I have all sorts of items I could recommend...

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: For example, this lion's tooth pendant with Vennessa's name carved into it. It was once a medal awarded to a knight by the great lady herself!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think what Lisa means is...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The library book you borrowed.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Oh my goodness! I do apologize, I got so excited when you mentioned Vennessa.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: I didn't know that book was overdue. Even though I take it with me everywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: I can't believe I didn't put two and two together as soon as I saw you here, haha... Here you go.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: *sigh* Well, since you look up to Lady Vennessa so very much... Please be more punctual next time.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Yes, Lisa. I will be, Lisa.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Let's go and find the next overdue book.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: *sigh* Well, if you insist... I will just use them as an extra pair of pajamas.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: My my, you clearly know a treasure when you see it. This is a work of unparalleled significance for the research of ancient people's understanding of the elements. I will gladly accept it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: It is said that the gift of a voodoo doll is certain to curse its recipient. Although, magic of this level certainly wouldn't have any effect on me.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: But you're probably innocent to such things. Since you're just a traveler, I will pretend that none of this ever happened.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I suppose it's not completely useless... I'll let Razor borrow it when it's time for his enhancement training.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Bloomers

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: This pair? Soft, puffy, and very comfortable. Certain to make a little girl — well, in this case, a woman — look quite adorable.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: After all, they're the same kind worn by toy dolls. They're practically a badge of cuteness.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Bloomers? I'm sure to attract some strange looks if I dress up like a small child in public. Do you have some strange... hobby you're not telling me about?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>bloomers</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What does Marjorie think?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Me? You're asking me? Erm... I feel like Lisa is the well-educated type.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Ah, that's right — I heard she enjoys <color=#00E1FFFF>items of historical interest</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Voodoo doll.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: This is the toy doll I was talking about earlier — doesn't she look lovely in those shorts?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Hmm... It does look a little bit terrifying, doesn't it? I wonder if you could find some other use for it...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Voodoo doll? Have you lost your mind? What could I have possibly done to deserve this?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>voodoo doll</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!

talks.objective: Talk to Sara about returning the library book

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Welcome to Good Hunter. Table for two?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: THREE!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Oh, haha! My apologies... Please sit wherever you like and call me over once you're ready to order.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So we're gonna eat first and bring up the book situation later?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Why, of course. The stress of work really takes the pleasure out of eating, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Work is that bad, huh?

talks.objective: Order a dish Lisa would like

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Regarding Lisa's taste in food...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: What does Lisa like to eat?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: She's been here a few times with Master Jean for afternoon tea before. I think she normally orders <color=#00E1FFFF>something vegetarian</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: A lady tends to eat cautiously on account of her physique, after all! On that note, I should probably be watching my own diet a little more...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Finished ordering? Sit here, let's dine together.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Radish Veggie Soup

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I imagine that making a good vegetable soup takes good quality ingredients cooked in the right order at the right heat for the right length of time.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: At least, those are the principles that apply when one is making potions. But from what I've heard, soup-making was a popular pastime among the witches of the past.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>Radish Veggie Soup</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: A fine choice! I'm pleasantly surprised.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: A truly enchanting dish, certainly a good fit for a witch. I am simply brimming with elemental energy after that.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: The ingredients are fresh — the Good Hunter certainly lives up to its reputation in that respect. Salad as a meal is a little bland, though — it always feels like there's something missing.

talks.objective: Sit down and dine with Lisa

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Finished ordering? Sit here, let's dine together.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Would you like to order something else?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: No thank you, we're quite satisfied. But I'm afraid I must ask you about "The Boar Princess"—

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: The Boar Brisket? I'm sorry, I think we took that off the menu.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She means the book you borrowed!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Oh! Of course! I came straight to the restaurant after I borrowed it and completely forgot that I even had it.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: I'm so sorry Lisa, I will bring it to the library myself as soon as I finish work.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Mm... Okay then. But make sure you don't forget this time.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: #Right, onto our next stop then, {NICKNAME}.

talks.objective: Talk to Donna and find out what happened

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Okay, time to get back to business. Donna, do you know why we're here?

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Back to business? My business is selling flowers!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: *sigh* Once again, we see a total lack of respect for literature...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies</color>. Ring a bell?

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Oh! Ahh, yes, well, what happened was... was...

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Oh no, what am I gonna do?

response.speaker: Donna
response.text: I... I lost the book.

response.speaker: Donna
response.text: A while back, I realized it was almost due and I was getting ready to bring it back to the library.

response.speaker: Donna
response.text: But I couldn't find it anywhere. I looked for days — but nothing.

response.speaker: Donna
response.text: It's like somebody stole it... It should have been there, on my bedside table. Right where I left it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-oh... Bet Lisa does some crazy things when she gets mad!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I heard that!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eek!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Well, if it really was stolen, Donna's done nothing wrong.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: The blame lies with the book thief.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: And their punishment will be three— No, ten times worse than stealing my book.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Like Paimon said! Totally crazy!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How do we...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How do we find the lost book though?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Oh, don't worry about that. As long as I remain librarian, not a single book will go missing for good.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I put a unique elemental marker on each book. Our thief will have left a nice set of clues for us to follow.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: When did Lisa start taking her job so seriously!? Paimon always thought she was a total slacker.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hey sweetie, I've heard your elemental sensitivity is very strong... Why not see what you can do?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Elemental sensitivity? Oh! Paimon's got it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, use your <color=#00E1FFFF>Elemental Sight</color> to look for clues!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: This is our final call for the day.

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Welcome...! Uh... c—couples are our specialty! Let me know what you'd like and I'll wrap them up nicely for you.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Ah yes... Now which book was it that has the line, "a date without flowers is a date without romance"?

choices.text: Would you by any chance care for some flowers, milady?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Why, it just so happens that I would, my kindest cutie.

choices.text: No idea which book. Never even heard the line before.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ugh, {NICKNAME}. Take. The. Hint.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hehe, never mind, your ignorance is somehow rather adorable.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Since you're here, and Lisa is here, and this is a flower shop... You might as well get a bunch of flowers, right? It only makes sense.

response.speaker: Donna
response.text: Some flowers for Miss Lisa? What would you like?\n<color=#00E1FFFF>(Pick a kind that Lisa will like)</color>

talks.objective: Result: Lisa in a good mood (Hidden)

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Yes

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Dandelions? They actually sell dandelions?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: They have a refreshing scent, similar to the one Jean wears. Thank you.

talks.objective: Result: Lisa in an average mood (Hidden)

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Yes

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Huh? These flowers are saturated with Cryo energy. They could be very dangerous for me.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Don't you know what happens when Cryo meets Electro? *Tut-tut* You certainly haven't been doing your homework.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Meet me at the library after work and I will give you some training on elemental reactions. If you still find it hard to memorize... Maybe I'll have you give you a little taste of what it feels like to superconduct.

talks.objective: Result: Lisa in a bad mood (Hidden)

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Yes

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I can see you put a lot of thought into this, have you ever heard of the Witch of Purple Rose before?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I thought that after returning to Mondstadt I wouldn't have the chance to see fresh roses again.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: This seems like a good sign.

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Yes

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Ooh la-la, such fine taste.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: This rare flower is only found in Mondstadt's very highest mountains.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: If only you had picked them for me with your own hands... They would have had twice the sentimental value.

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: What does Donna think?

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: You want my help? I don't know if I have the best taste in flowers... Why don't you go ask Miss <color=#00E1FFFF>Flora</color>, the shop owner?

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: I couldn't help but notice the flower on Miss Lisa's hat though — I think it's a <color=#00E1FFFF>Rose</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: What kind of flowers does Lisa like?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: You want to know what flowers to get for Miss Lisa?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: We're not particularly close, but she strikes me as a classy lady!

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Hmm... Yep, it can only be the <color=#00E1FFFF>Cecilia</color>!

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Dandelion

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Dandelions are one of our classics, and a personal favorite of Miss Flora, the shop owner.

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: I know what you're thinking: Most flower shops don't sell dandelions, they're a nuisance to care for... Perhaps Miss Flora likes the sense of floating away to a faraway land that the dandelion evokes?

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, Miss Flora herself gives people the same impression.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>Dandelion</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!

talks.objective: Search for the book's elemental marks
Talk to Lisa to understand what the clue means

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Looking at the elemental traces, it does seem likely that the book was stolen.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So Donna didn't do anything wrong after all.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: It's not from the restricted section, so it's hardly a book worth stealing.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Whoever wanted this book so badly had a strange fixation indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... so what do we do now?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: The <color=#00E1FFFF>elemental traces</color> are very faint, but I can tell that the thief took it beyond the city walls.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: #You must see it too, right, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Let's follow the trail and have a little look where our thief was headed, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ragged old scroll.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: This is a historical relic retrieved from some ruins by one of the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Sure, there's a bit of wear and tear, but this thing in the painting must be well over a thousand years old... though it doesn't make much sense to me.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: My goodness... This is one of the three lost scrolls that make up the "Northern Border Wind Investigation..." What is it doing here!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>ragged old scroll</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Rusty sword.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: This is a new arrival. It took three Adventurers to carry this big boy back from the ruins where they found it.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: It comes with a lot of history as well as a lot of weight.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hmm... You do have strange tastes. If this is your way of saying you want to be my knight in shining armor, I'd rather you just say the words instead.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>rusty sword</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: #*yawn*... Why don't you order us something, {NICKNAME}? I'm ever so curious to know what your tastes are.\n<color=#00E1FFFF>(Pick a dish that Lisa will like)</color>

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Steak

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Good Hunter's signature dish. If it's what you want, I'll try anything once.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>Steak</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Northern Smoked Chicken

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: This seems like the sort of staple bar food you'd find at the tavern. It has an extremely strong flavor, so drinkers love it because they can actually taste it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>Northern Smoked Chicken</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Satisfying Salad

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Eating salad is like piling on more and more elemental power. Raw, unfettered energy applied indiscriminately, with no elegance or control.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: It's the first mistake all magic users make when they're learning. But then again... if one genuinely had so much pure elemental power that they could solve any problem they wanted... that would be a different matter entirely.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>Satisfying Salad</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait a moment...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Mm... beautifully tender and cooked to perfection. No wonder it's their signature dish. It's a shame I can't have more, but a witch must watch her physique.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hmm, such a potent aroma... It's almost suffocating. I never thought someone your age would go for a dish like this...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I always had you down as a little cutie... Now I'm not so sure.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe later.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Wow, Jean must have given you some pointers? Such extraordinary lengths to prepare for a delicious meal... I'd almost say that's cheating.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I didn't know you and Jean got on so well. She used to make this for me once in a while too.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: As it happens, this is exactly what I was craving — the perfect treat after a tiresome day of work. You've outdone yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Mist Flower

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Mist Flowers? Over there in the corner... but don't touch them with your bare hands. You'll get frostbite.

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: You want them? You're sure? What an unusual choice...

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: It's just that Lisa seems to use Electro quite a lot. Things could get a little bit dangerous...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>Mist Flower</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Rose

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: These roses were bought from a traveling merchant a few days ago.

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Miss Flora thought maybe someone would like them... This is the only bunch.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>Rose</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Cecilia

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Ah, the Cecilia. Did Miss Flora recommend it to you?

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: This flower is a lot of effort to care for. I hope that I've been doing it right, otherwise they won't last long.

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: But part of the Cecilia's charm is how precious and fragile each one is...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You sure you wanna pick the <color=#00E1FFFF>Cecilia</color>? <color=#00E1FFFF>Can't change again</color> once you've made your mind up!

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: I'll be back shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: No

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: *sigh* How could I lose it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Invigorating Pizza

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
